description: Alterations to the interior layout including the relocation of the kitchen and dining area and re-instatement of the fireplace to the lower ground floor with the creation of a utility space. Relocation of the living room from the ground floor, creation of an opening between the lower ground floor rooms and the renovation of the lower ground floor bathroom. Relocation of the study to the ground floor and bedrooms to the upper first and second floors with the renovation of the second floor bathroom and the renovation of the interior of the existing rear outbuilding also incorporating upgrades to electrics and plumbing
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (21-43-02, 21-43-03, 21-43-04, Unnumbered Lower Ground Proposed Floor Plans, Unnumbered Ground Floor Proposed Floor Plans, Unnumbered First Floor Proposed Plans, Unnumbered Second Floor Proposed Floor Plans, Design & Access Statement, Heritage Statement and Impact Assessment Received 28 July 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: Planning and listed building consent to remove the existing rear outbuilding and lower the garden level to accommodate a lower-ground floor extension were refused consent on 30 June 2022 (ref. 00185/46/P2 and 00189/46/L4).
